title: Admission Cell
answer: Admission Cell is located on the Ground Floor of the Main Building. Students can visit here for admission enquiries, document verification, counselling and new admission related support.

title: Accounts Cell
answer: Accounts Cell is located on the Ground Floor of the Main Building. Visit here for fee payment, receipts, dues and financial queries.

title: Registrar Office
answer: Registrar Office is located on the Ground Floor of the Main Building. It handles official university records, certificates and administrative matters.

title: Placement Cell
answer: Placement Cell is located on the Ground Floor of the Main Building. Students can visit for campus placements, internships, career guidance and company recruitment.

title: Examination Cell
answer: Examination Cell is located on the First Floor of the Main Building. Students can visit for examination forms, admit cards, results and examination related queries.

title: Library
answer: Central Library is located on the First Floor of the Main Building. Students can borrow books, access journals, digital resources and use the reading room.
